research_notes: Initial research 2026-10-01: frozen occupation extract, official APH/party biography, first speech, public professional index, historical Queensland minister diary, Tasmanian Estimates attendance, MTAA annual report, AMCHAM directory, Scottish Enterprise announcement, ARN interview and Broadcom acquisition record. Roster unchanged.

Private corporate government-affairs work is not political staff merely because it involves government; TCCI and MTAA are employer associations excluded under the codebook. Giddings and Winter office employment is political staff.

No substantive full-time designation found for any dated role. Cadetship/study and MBA overlaps need hours and leave evidence. Senior titles do not prove full-time status. Need 2019–20 interval and 2024–25 political-office boundaries.

Companies House historical Faraday filings identified at https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/10360764/filing-history?page=2; persons-with-significant-control page returned Internal Error without code. Historical control left unknown; government-funded trade mission not evidence of government control.

November 2024 Australian reporting indexed Meta departure June and return to Hobart in August for Winter in Mercury reporting; no complete accessible primary appointment document established those dates. Preserve as follow-up leads. Winter employment itself corroborated in accessible December analysis.
Do not confuse UK VMware vExpert Rich Dowling/virtRich, a Sydney Kong customer-experience professional, Irish politician, radiologist or pianist with this senator. No personal contacts collected.

Follow-up: Treasury cadet/analyst hours and transition, dated employer professional history, KFC legal employer, company control/contract details, exact private role endpoints, 2019–20 and 2024–25 gaps, study/campaign leave. Government and employer primary records may refine boundaries; totals remain unknown.
